ns2:group.ns2:title: “不开玩笑” × 罗永浩的十字路口！折腾未必会赢，但不折腾一定会后悔 | Jokes Aside, Try Anyway
ns2:group.ns2:description:
本期节目是《罗永浩的十字路口》和《不开玩笑》联名款现场。在这个《罗永浩的十字路口》第二十期（乱斗篇）中，罗永浩和史炎、宋方金、孙书恒、刘仁铖这几位朋友，打着讨论“折腾”这个严肃话题的幌子，进行了数小时的互相伤害；同时在互黑互损互殴的刀光剑影中，顺便聊到了创业与折腾，失败与再战，天赋与缺陷，音乐与舞蹈，手机与卤味，神经病与精神病等等。并在最后人模狗样地得出深刻的结论：折腾未必会赢，但不折腾一定会后悔。
This episode is a live crossover between Luo Yonghao and Jokes Aside's friends.
In this twentieth episode — the “free-for-all edition” — Luo Yonghao joins Shi Yan, Song Fangjin, Sun Shuheng, and Liu Rencheng under the pretense of discussing the serious topic of “折腾” — restlessness, hustle, the urge to disrupt one’s own life.
What follows is hours of mutual damage.
Behind the rapid-fire teasing, sharp jabs, and barely contained chaos, they talk about entrepreneurship and experimentation, failure and returning to battle, talent and limitation, music and dance, smartphones and braised snacks, neurosis and madness — and everything in between. Somewhere within the friendly fire, something real emerges.
And in the end, in a surprisingly dignified tone, they arrive at a simple conclusion: You might not win by trying, but you will definitely regret not trying.

ns0:entry.ns0:title: [罗永浩的十字路口]音乐人张玮玮 × 罗永浩！我们都是那个“混乱又伟大”的90年代的幸存者 | Zhang Weiwei: Survivors of a “Great and Chaotic” 90s

ns2:group.ns2:title: 音乐人张玮玮 × 罗永浩！我们都是那个“混乱又伟大”的90年代的幸存者 | Zhang Weiwei: Survivors of a “Great and Chaotic” 90s
ns2:group.ns2:description: 如果你曾以为《米店》就是张玮玮的全部，那你可能误读了他，也误读了那个被他称为“伟大的混乱”的 90 年代。从甘肃白银的矿坑烟尘，到广州大石镇的廉价饼干，从北京地下通道的嘶吼，到云南大理的舒适陷阱，张玮玮的人生轨迹，是一部中国独立音乐人的流浪史，也是一部为了对抗平庸与麻木而不断自我放逐的奥德赛。 《罗永浩的十字路口》第十九期，罗永浩与张玮玮——这两个同样从 90 年代“野蛮生长”出来的老友，进行了一场长达近六小时的，密度极高，情感浓度也非常深厚的对谈。他们聊到了那些早已消失的地标：河酒吧的烟雾、无名高地的喧嚣、“金钱豹”奢华餐厅里跟音乐毫无关系的歌唱。 张玮玮坦诚地剖析了自己从“站在角落的乐手”被迫走向台前成为“主唱”的恐惧，也毫不避讳地谈及中年危机时那只被风吹起的塑料袋。他轻轻抖掉了人们贴给他的“民谣”标签，用合成器和电子乐构建了新的《索拉里斯星》，只因他不愿在一个固化的梦境里沉睡。这是一次关于活着、关于尊严、关于如何在废墟之上重建自我的深度对话。 If you once believed Rice Shop was all there to Zhang Weiwei, then you may have misread both him — and the decade he calls a “great chaos”: the 1990s. From the coal-dusted mines of Baiyin, Gansu, to cheap biscuits in Guangzhou’s Dashi Town; from the raw howls of Beijing’s underground passages to the seductive comfort of Dali’s slow-life trap — Zhang Weiwei’s life traces the wandering path of a Chinese independent musician, and an odyssey of constant self-exile in resistance to mediocrity and numbness. In Episode 19 of Crossroads with Luo Yonghao, Luo Yonghao and Zhang Weiwei — two old friends shaped by the same wild, untamed 1990s — sit down for an almost six-hour conversation, dense with memory and heavy with emotion. They revisit places that no longer exist: the smoke-filled He Bar, the chaos of Wuming Gaodi, the absurd singing at Golden Leopard —the once famous luxury buffet with nothing to do with music. Zhang Weiwei speaks candidly about the fear of being pushed from a musician in the corner into the spotlight as a “frontman.” He talks openly about his midlife crisis — and the plastic bag lifted by the wind that came to symbolize it. He gently shakes off the “folk” label placed upon him, building a new Solaris with synthesizers and electronic sound — simply because he refuses to fall asleep inside a frozen dream. This is a deep conversation about living, about dignity, and about how one rebuilds the self on top of ruins.

ns0:entry.ns0:title: [罗永浩的十字路口]蒋奇明 & 双雪涛 × 罗永浩！如何成为飞行家 | Jiang Qiming & Shuang Xuetao: Born to Take Off

ns2:group.ns2:title: 蒋奇明 & 双雪涛 × 罗永浩！如何成为飞行家 | Jiang Qiming & Shuang Xuetao: Born to Take Off
ns2:group.ns2:description:
最初，大家都是呱呱落地，但有些人落地，就是为了离开地面，飞向天空。 演员蒋奇明，从话剧舞台转向影视镜头不过短短数年，就已经塑造出多个令人难忘的角色——完美诠释了“沉默震耳欲聋”的傅卫军，总在边缘挣扎的王安全，胸怀壮志但一生身不由己的李明奇......他和他所扮演的角色一样，都被生活的重力紧紧束缚，但从没放弃过“仰望星空”。 作家&编剧双雪涛，多年来笔耕不辍，用文字完成了一次次冷静而又惊艳的探索。在他笔下，在那片老东北废弃工业区锈色的天空下，总有些人不甘心任由命运摆弄，执意寻找属于自己的升力。 或许正因为曾经对抗过地面，如今他们比任何人都懂得“离地三米五”的珍贵，当蒋奇明和双雪涛相遇在电影《飞行家》，角色和文本互为翅膀，让“飞行”不再仅仅是隐喻，而是同时去往两个一样蔚蓝的天空。 《罗永浩的十字路口》第十八期，我们节目首次迎来双嘉宾的对谈——演员蒋奇明与作家双雪涛。
We all enter the world the same way — but some people land only to leave the ground, to rise toward the sky. Actor Jiang Qiming moved from the theater stage to the film camera only a few years ago, yet he has already shaped a series of unforgettable roles — characters whose silence roars, who struggle at the margins, who carry ambition while bound by fate. Like the roles he portrays, Jiang lives under the pull of gravity — but he has never stopped looking up. Writer and screenwriter Shuang Xuetao has spent years writing steadily, completing one cool yet astonishing exploration after another. In his work, beneath the rust-colored skies of Northeast China’s abandoned industrial zones, there are always people who refuse to be handled by fate — who insist on finding their own lift. Perhaps because they have both fought against the ground, they now understand better than anyone the value of being three and a half meters above it. When Jiang Qiming and Shuang Xuetao meet in the film Take Off, character and text become each other’s wings — and flight is no longer just a metaphor, but two parallel ascents toward the same blue sky. In this eighteenth episode of Crossroads with Luo Yonghao, we welcome our first dual-guest conversation — actor Jiang Qiming and writer Shuang Xuetao — to talk about creation, gravity, and what it means to be born to take off.

ns0:entry.ns0:title: [罗永浩的十字路口]刘震云×罗永浩！有些玩笑含着泪也要开完 ｜ Liu Zhenyun: Some Jokes to Cry For

ns2:group.ns2:title: 刘震云×罗永浩！有些玩笑含着泪也要开完 ｜ Liu Zhenyun: Some Jokes to Cry For
ns2:group.ns2:description:
时隔四年，刘震云老师带着他的新书《咸的玩笑》和我们进行了一次长谈。这一次故事又发生在家乡河南延津，又是一群失意的不知道找谁诉说的人们，又是一些生活中无可奈何的小事，最后不动声色地卷起狂风暴雨。几十年的文学创作让他成为了一个人类观察家，别人看到的是如常的生活，他说这里边全是哲学问题；别人听到的是玩笑，他却察觉了玩笑的味道，有些玩笑是咸的，因为开玩笑的人含着眼泪。那些平凡的日子，遗落了一些珍贵的东西，刘震云将它们捡起，用文字串了起来。他带着我们读懂了那些埋藏在冰冷世界里的异彩和辛酸。 《罗永浩的十字路口》第十七期，我们邀请了作家刘震云，谈谈他的新作，谈谈他的往事，谈谈那些即便流着泪也要开完的玩笑。
Four years later, Liu Zhenyun returns for a long and intimate conversation — inspired by his new book 咸的玩笑. Once again, the stories take us back to his hometown — Yanjin, Henan. Once again, we meet ordinary people who don’t know where to take their grievances, small helpless moments of daily life, and storms that gather quietly, without warning. Decades of writing have shaped him into a careful observer of humanity. Where others see ordinary life, he sees philosophy. Where others hear jokes, he hears something deeper — some jokes are salty, because they are told with tears. From those ordinary days, precious things are often left behind. Liu Zhenyun picks them up, strings them together with words, and brings us to the hidden colors and quiet pain buried beneath a cold world. In this seventeenth episode of Crossroads with Luo Yonghao, we sit down with Liu Zhenyun to talk about his new book, his past, and the jokes we cry for.

ns0:entry.ns0:title: [罗永浩的十字路口]Lovart 创始人陈冕×罗永浩！且让我大闹一场，然后悄然离去 ｜ Melvin Chen: Let Me Shake the World, Then Walk Away

ns2:group.ns2:title: Lovart 创始人陈冕×罗永浩！且让我大闹一场，然后悄然离去 ｜ Melvin Chen: Let Me Shake the World, Then Walk Away
ns2:group.ns2:description:
陈冕是一个天生的创业者，永远有新想法，永远跃跃欲试，永远准备战斗。他可能也的确是当下商战经验最丰富的创业者，因为他曾用 10 年时间集齐了几乎所有互联网大厂的工作履历，并亲身参与了一系列著名的商战。对他来说，打工是创业的预备期，他不断地吸收、总结、思考，等待着机会，一个让他义无反顾冲出去证明自己的机会，他等了好久，一度他以为自己生错了时代，直到那年冬天 AI 来了，他说自己得到了救赎。
去年，他和他的创业团队推出了设计类的 AI Agent 产品 Lovart，在海外取得了现象级的成功，业内评价和收入规模都极为亮眼，叫好又叫座。
在去年年底的十字路口科技创新分享大会上，我们将 Lovart 选为年度最佳图形图像类 AI 应用。但可惜因为时间的关系，最终没能现场讲解，日后我们会专门拍摄演示视频弥补这个遗憾。在这之前，让我们先用一场长谈，来认识一下这个积蓄了巨大能量、决心要大闹一场的年轻人。
《罗永浩的十字路口》第十六期，让我们和 Lovart 创始人陈冕，聊聊他的创业之路。
Melvin Chen is a born entrepreneur. He always has new ideas. He is always restless. Always ready for battle. He may also be one of the most battle-tested founders of his generation. Over ten years, he collected almost every major Chinese tech company on his résumé, personally witnessing — and participating in — some of the most famous corporate battles of the internet era. For him, employment was never the destination. It was preparation. He absorbed, summarized, and waited — for a moment worth charging into without hesitation. For a long time, he believed he was born in the wrong era. Then, one winter, AI arrived. He says he was redeemed. Last year, Melvin and his team launched Lovart, a design-focused AI agent that achieved phenomenal success overseas — earning both critical acclaim and commercial scale. At our 2025 Crossroads Technology & Innovation Conference, Lovart was selected as Best Graphic & Imaging AI Application of the Year. Though time didn’t allow us for a live demo, we will return with a dedicated walkthrough video soon. Before that — let’s meet the young founder who has been quietly gathering energy, preparing to make his storm. In this sixteenth episode of Crossroads with Luo Yonghao, we sit down with Lovart founder Melvin Chen to talk about his entrepreneurial journey.

ns0:entry.ns0:title: [罗永浩的十字路口]【正片】影石Insta360 创始人刘靖康×罗永浩！比生存更重要的是那些微小的念头 ｜ Insta360's JK Liu: Think Bold, Start Small

ns2:group.ns2:title: 【正片】影石Insta360 创始人刘靖康×罗永浩！比生存更重要的是那些微小的念头 ｜ Insta360's JK Liu: Think Bold, Start Small
ns2:group.ns2:description:
一段传奇，一个全世界瞩目的创业项目，一场被时代铭记的伟大冒险，很可能就来自于内心里一次微小的起心动念。 在刘靖康的成长过程里，他无数次地被这种念头撞击着，总忍不住要创造些什么。从上学时，他的锋芒就藏不住了，他频频利用高超的计算机技术和天马行空的想法，制造出轰动校园乃至整个社会的热点事件。 终于，他开始了自己的创业之路，他的创造欲彻底爆发，他在不同的细分场景里重新发明着相机，改变着人们记录生活的方式。他和他的公司都还很年轻，但他们的发明已经打开了诸多的新市场，解决了没人解决过的问题，以一个挑战者的姿态成长为新的巨头。 他有足够的时间把奇思妙想带到更多的地方，也积累了足够的能力去找到更多内心里晃动着火苗的人们，让那些小小的冲动创造出巨大的快乐。 《罗永浩的十字路口》第十五期，我们和 Insta360 的创始人刘靖康聊聊他的创业和他的创造。
A legend, a world-famous startup, a great adventure remembered by its time — often begin with nothing more than a small, quiet thought. In JK Liu’s life, these thoughts have struck again and again. From his school days, his sharpness could never stay hidden. With exceptional programming skill and fearless imagination, he created moments that shook not only his campus, but society beyond it. And then he began his own journey. His drive to create fully ignited. Across different scenarios and everyday moments, he re-invented the camera — changing how people record their lives. Though he and his company are still young, their inventions have already opened new markets, solved problems no one had solved before, and grown from challengers into new giants. Think Bold — not as a slogan, but as a way of seeing the world. He has the time to carry his wild ideas into more places, and the ability to find others whose inner sparks are quietly flickering — turning small impulses into vast joy. In this fifteenth episode of Crossroads with Luo Yonghao, we talk with Insta360 founder JK Liu about entrepreneurship, invention, and the small thoughts that change everything.

ns0:entry.ns0:title: [罗永浩的十字路口]【正片】导演大鹏×罗永浩！我这两辈子 ｜ Da Peng: The Life Before, and the Life After

ns2:group.ns2:title: 【正片】导演大鹏×罗永浩！我这两辈子 ｜ Da Peng: The Life Before, and the Life After
ns2:group.ns2:description:
大鹏说，自己有时候感觉像活了两辈子。第一个大鹏从小镇怀着梦想闯荡北京，走得磕磕绊绊，遍体鳞伤。那时候的他永远站在角落，站在聚光灯旁边的阴影处。他努力地采访、主持、拍戏，接各种杂活儿，拼命尝试向舞台中央靠近…… 说不清究竟是哪一天，第二个大鹏发现自己站到了聚光灯下，结果很多人都要跟他重新认识一遍，因为他们大都不记得眼前这个人，不记得其实他们早就见过面。现在的他，无论是导演还是表演，无论是产量还是质量，拿出的都是扎扎实实的成绩。无论是作为导演还是演员，他离这个行业的最高荣誉也不止一次地只有半步之遥。可他还是不能放松，他总是想起第一个大鹏。他觉得一切本该做得更好，他心里好像总是有无限的遗憾、不安，和伴随着焦虑的更高目标。我们非常非常感谢他的信任，感谢他在这个超长的访谈中几乎毫无保留地呈现给了我们两个大鹏，两个命运截然不同但同样温暖柔软真诚的大鹏。
《罗永浩的十字路口》第十四期，我们和大鹏聊聊他的两辈子。
For director and actor Da Peng, it sometimes feels like he has lived two lives.
The first began in a small town, carrying dreams into Beijing — stumbling forward, bruised and worn down. In those years, he stood at the edges: in the shadows beside the spotlight, never quite at its center. He interviewed, hosted, acted, took on every odd job he could find, trying desperately to move closer to the stage.
Then, one day — without a clear dividing line — the second Da Peng realized he had stepped into the light. And strangely, many people felt they were meeting him for the first time, forgetting that they had already crossed paths before.
Today, whether as a director or an actor, Da Peng delivers work defined by both consistency and quality. More than once, he has stood just half a step away from the highest honors in the industry. And yet, he never allows himself to relax.
He keeps thinking about the first Da Peng. He feels things could have been done better. Inside him live endless regret, unease, and ambitions that rise alongside anxiety.
We are deeply grateful for his trust — for allowing us, in this extended conversation, to meet both versions of Da Peng. Two lives, shaped by different fates, yet sharing the same warmth, softness, and sincerity.
In this fourteenth episode of Crossroads with Luo Yonghao, we talk with Da Peng about the two lives he has lived.

ns2:group.ns2:title: 【正片】MiniMax 创始人闫俊杰×罗永浩！大山并非无法翻越 Founder of MiniMax - The Mountain Awaits to Be Crossed
ns2:group.ns2:description:
闫俊杰似乎很擅长通关。他出生在小县城，一路读到了清华博士后，又从商汤的实习生一路做到了副总裁。但这些还不够，他的敏锐、他的决心、他的抱负一直在提醒他应该走出来，参与到世界的变革中来，于是在 AI 革命到来的前一年，他成立了 AI 大模型公司 MiniMax，这个公司的名字好像也在描述着起点和终点。他希望中国的厂商可以成为引领世界的巨头，他希望 AI 能够改变每一个普通人的生活。他看起来安静沉着，可内心对竞争充满期待，期待着跟王者一决高下，期待着他亲手将少数精英的工具变为普惠大众的生产力。
《罗永浩的十字路口》第十三期，我们和 MiniMax 创始人闫俊杰聊一聊他的 AI 创业之路。
Yan Junjie seems remarkably good at clearing levels. Born in a small county town, he made his way to a Tsinghua postdoc and rose from intern to Vice President at SenseTime. But even that wasn’t enough. His sensitivity, resolve, and ambition kept reminding him that he needed to step out — to take part in reshaping the world. One year before the arrival of the AI revolution, he founded MiniMax, a frontier AI model company whose name feels like a metaphor for both origin and destination. He hopes Chinese companies can become global leaders. He hopes AI can transform the lives of everyday people. He appears quiet and composed, yet inside he carries a fierce anticipation for competition — the desire to challenge the giants and to personally turn elite tools into accessible productivity for all. In this thirteenth episode of Crossroads with Luo Yonghao, we speak with MiniMax founder Yan Junjie about his AI journey, his entrepreneurial conviction, and the transformation he believes is coming.

ns2:group.ns2:description:
才华这件事终究是无法解释的。毕赣的成长很像是得到了一个艺术创作的火种，让他完全凭借直觉和自学形成了属于他的美学体系，而这些恰好能以诗一样的电影作为出口。但令人更加意外的是，他同时还兼具另一种才华——能将混沌的艺术理念和模糊的生命体验讲述清楚的能力。我谈到了很多在艺术上长久以来的困惑，他三言两语就让人豁然开朗。这一次，他在大银幕上带来了绵延一个世纪的梦境，又在这场超长的谈话中带来了“梦的解析”。
《罗永浩的十字路口》第十二期，我们和导演毕赣聊聊他的梦，他的艺术观和他的狂野时代。
Talent, in the end, is something that defies explanation. Bi Gan’s artistic path feels like receiving a spark — a fire of creation lit impossibly early — allowing him to build an entire aesthetic universe guided only by instinct and self-study. From his debut Kaili Blues onward, his films have become outlets for that fire — poems written in light and time. What’s even more astonishing is his second gift: the ability to articulate the chaos of artistic intuition and the blur of lived experience with extraordinary clarity. We brought up questions we’d carried for years about art, and with just a few sentences, he opened a door. With Resurrection — premiered at Cannes and soon to be released theatrically around the world — he brings us dreamscapes that stretch across a century. In this long-form conversation, he also brings us an “interpretation of dreams” — a map to the mysterious world from which his images grow. In this twelfth episode of Crossroads with Luo Yonghao, we talk with Bi Gan about dreams, art, and his newest film, Resurrection.

ns2:group.ns2:title: 【正片】何同学×罗永浩！青年何同学的骄傲与烦恼 ｜ CrossRoads Ep.11: The Pride and Confusion of HTX Studio
ns2:group.ns2:description: He Tongxue — known online as HTX Studio — carries a lean, youthful frame, yet everything he faces feels immense. Immense attention, immense praise, and immense controversy. He stands like someone chosen by the times, as the waves of a restless digital era surge toward him. Calm in the storm, he crafts each video with care and precision — building a fortress out of his dedication to creation. That fortress is his pride, his shield, and the small vessel carrying him across an uncertain sea. He calls himself lucky, even though he doesn’t know what lies ahead. The boat keeps moving — sometimes in fog, sometimes in clarity — but always forward. In this eleventh episode of Crossroads with Luo Yonghao, we sit down with HTX Studio to talk about his videos, his anxieties, and the unforgettable moments that shaped his youth.

ns2:group.ns2:title: 【正片】魔术大师刘谦 × 罗永浩！你所不知道的刘谦 ｜ CrossRoads Ep.10: The Magic You Don’t Know
ns2:group.ns2:description: Lu Chen believes there are two kinds of magic. One makes the audience say, “Wow, that’s amazing — how did you do that?” The other leaves them breathless, whispering, “That’s impossible… what just happened?” He says it’s the second kind that lingers — the one that stays in your mind for years, echoing long after the trick ends. Lu Chen is a magician of pure materialist belief — yet he’s devoted his life to leaving traces of real magic in people’s hearts. In this tenth episode of Crossroads with Luo Yonghao, we sit down with the famous magician Lu Chen. In this in-depth conversation, he performs and dissects the craft with razor-sharp insight and astonishing demonstrations — revealing the truth, philosophy, and psychology behind illusion itself. He shares stories that blur the boundary between science and wonder, reason and mystery, reminding us that magic isn’t about deception — it’s about rediscovering belief. This is Lu Chen as you’ve never seen him before — a master revealing not just his art, but his mind. 魔术大师刘谦把魔术分为两种，一种是观众看了会说“哇，好厉害，你怎么做到的？”还有一种是观众会觉得，“天呐！这不可能！刚刚发生了什么？！” 他说，后一种，会给在场的人留下回味终生的绝妙体验。 刘谦是彻底的唯物主义魔术师，可他一直致力于给观众的心里留下魔法的踪迹。在这个超长的访谈中，他通过一连串让人拍案叫绝的故事和令人头皮发麻的演绎，完成了对魔术的正本清源和深度揭秘，阐述了他对这个行业的深刻理解和终极追求。也给我们心中所谓魔术的价值和意义，赋予了一层前所未有的认知。

ns2:group.ns2:title: 【正片】贾樟柯×罗永浩！成为贾樟柯（上） ｜ CrossRoads Ep.9: Becoming Jia Zhangke: Part One
ns2:group.ns2:description:
Director Jia Zhangke joins CrossRoads with Luo Yonghao for an intimate conversation on cinema, memory, and becoming himself. From Platform to Still Life, his lens captures ordinary people and fading times — revealing the quiet pulse of China’s transformation.
While most cameras chase neon skylines and tales of heroes, Jia Zhangke’s lens has always stayed grounded — focused on the soil beneath his feet. In his films, there are few grand battles or dramatic rescues — only the quiet pulse of life in Shanxi’s small towns: coal mines, motorcycles, county dance troupes, drifting youth, and the fragile silhouettes of people caught between eras. Those forgotten by history find their voices in Jia’s frame — ordinary, steady, yet resonant — echoing from the skies over Fenyang to the nights of Venice. In this ninth episode of Crossroads with Luo Yonghao, we sit down with director Jia Zhangke, a filmmaker whose works (Platform, Still Life, A Touch of Sin, Mountains May Depart, Ash Is Purest White) continue to map the emotional geography of modern China. To converse with Jia is to step into his cinema: honest, grounded, calm, and deeply human. His words, like his images, reveal the unseen currents beneath ordinary life — where longing meets history, the mundane finds a voice, and silence tells its own truth. Together, we trace the journey of a once-restless youth wandering the streets of Fenyang — who found his way, step by step, to the Golden Lion stage of the Venice Film Festival. 《罗永浩的十字路口》播客节目简介 本节⽬是⼀档由罗永浩主持的深度播客类节⽬，每集长达三到五个小时。 我们与时代浪潮中的⼈物展开对话，聚焦于科技与⼈⽂领域，讲述个体命运故事，探讨时代发展趋势。
本期嘉宾：贾樟柯
在多数镜头都在追逐都市霓虹和英雄传奇时，贾樟柯的摄像机却始终对准他脚下的土地。他的电影画面中鲜少出现激烈的冲突，有的只是山西小城里随处可见的煤矿、摩托车、县城歌舞团、终日无所事事的少年，以及巨变的大时代背景下，一些踉踉跄跄，不知所措的身影。这些被宏大叙事忽略的人与事，在他的取景框里发出了低沉有力的轰鸣，让山西县城的天空和威尼斯的夜晚一起震颤。
《罗永浩的十字路口》第九期，我们的嘉宾是导演贾樟柯。
和贾樟柯对谈，就好像在看贾樟柯的电影。他的讲述如同他的镜头语言，真实，质朴，平静，偶尔有些跳跃，一如既往蕴藏着触碰心弦的力量。跟随他的叙述，我们将一起见证，那个曾经徘徊在汾阳街头的“问题少年”，是如何抵达威尼斯，并走到金狮奖的聚光灯下的。
